required_numerical_proofs.requirement: mutating pair frame_0 alone leaves SegNet input unchanged; mutating pair frame_1 can change SegNet logits

required_numerical_proofs.purpose: ties P19 Mahalanobis/Jacobian weighting back to contest MSE

required_numerical_proofs.name: rate_byte_price_exactness
